content_metadata.description: This video delves into the importance of neutron irradiation in studying flux pinning in superconductors. Prof. Harald W. Weber discusses the process and its impacts, providing insights into the intricacies of superconductivity research.

youtube_description:
Fast neutron irradiation introduces five nanometre scaled spherical centres of damage. This leads initially to a degradation of the reversible properties of oxide superconductors because their complex crystal structure has a high sensitivity to disorder. But, the resulting pinning centres enhance critical currents. 

A series of snippets on superconductivity. Courtesy of Professor Bartek Glowaki of the University of Cambridge, who filmed, directed and edited the videos.
